design.grid: all nonnegative fully invested weights in 5% steps (231)
design.rank: June 10bp CAGR / conservative MDD; no frequency, overlap or fee-ratio gate
design.accounting: update only the originating sleeve units; net actual units before fees and funding; 1x net cap at execution events
design.status: all periods already exposed; chronological diagnostic, not clean OOS; no live orders

policy.alias_grouping: sort by raw funding_time; group only adjacent rows whose timestamp delta from the previous row is <=100ms
policy.canonical_timestamp: latest raw timestamp in the accepted near-alias cluster; no snapping to cadence

caveats: Starts each window in cash and initializes known targets; OI position may be carried-in signal.
Legacy Gross9 not reconstructed here; no frozen recent REX source.
Net cap enforced at execution events, not continuous intrabar liquidation.
Regional trend retained despite weak standalone stress; no overlap rejection.
